name: Botreply.ai Live Chat
author: BotReply.ai

sections.description:
Botreply.ai Live Chat is an all-in-one customer experience solution that provides live chat and customer support tools for your website.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

Support

For support, email hello@botreply.ai .

External services

This plugin connects to an API to handle live chat, it’s needed to give the platform and the client the ability to text through the included widget.

This service is provided by “botreply.ai”: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/botreply-ai-live-chat directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the ‘Botreply.ai Live Chat’ menu to configure the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
How do I get a website token?

Register at Botreply.ai to obtain a website token.

Is this a free plugin?

Yes, the plugin is free.
